name: Cinders
source: A fairytale visual novel with beautiful illustrations from Gracjana Zielinska. Cinders is inspired by the classic fairytale of Cinderella, but puts more emphasis on character development and choices made by the protagonist. Did you ever wish that Cinderella would take her fate into her own hands, find a way to retake her residence from the evil stepmother, and ditch the prince in favor of the handsome captain?
translation: 這是一部童話題材視覺小說，配有Gracjana Zielinska繪製的精美插畫。《Cinders》從經典童話《灰姑娘》汲取靈感，卻更著重於角色成長和主角所作的選擇。你是否也曾希望灰姑娘能把命運掌握在自己手中，從邪惡繼母手裡奪回家園，再拋下王子，選擇英俊的衛隊長？
